thread:
alex: Quick thread to finalize DP prioritization rubric + minimum launch criteria before we open recruitment. want to keep it lightweight.

priya: Agree. propose 3-axis score per applicant: impact (0-5), feasibility (0-5), privacy/risk (0-5 but inverted). sum => 0-15. threshold >=9 to qualify.

jordan: Suggest clarifying feasibility: infra changes required, latency sensitivity, integration effort. add a checkbox for "requires on-prem/private" which automatically adds +− to feasibility score.

nina: For privacy/risk, can we add required mitigations? if partner scores high risk but agrees to redaction + proxy data, we can accept with legal sign-off.

legal-bot: FYI: we need explicit consent for sample prompt ingestion. Use short addendum A for telemetry + redaction commitments. I'll attach template.

alex: Good. For prioritization tie-breakers: 1) strategic customer (paid or roadmap influence), 2) workload diversity balance (chat/embeddings/batch), 3) uptime footprint (partners that exercise peak loads).

priya: Launch criteria draft: - 6 partners active across both primary workloads - >=75% partners complete at least 2 feedback cycles - infra SLOs: p95 latency within target, error rate <0.5% during sessions - product quality: no reproducible regression >5% on partner testset

jordan: Add rollout safety: feature flag per org, auto-fallback to stable model, 48h rollback window if regression detected.

ops-bot: Scheduled "DP intake review" Fri 09:00 PT (one-off)  https://calendar.example/evt/98765  RSVP to review candidates.

nina: On scope negotiation with partners: recommend a "min viable dataset" ask: 50-100 prompt examples + 1 week of traffic or synthetic outline if traffic low. we can prototype with synthetic if needed.

alex: Good point. Add a negotiation script: offer three scope options: A) Full logs + joint debugging (fast track), B) Redacted logs + periodic snapshots, C) No logs, only UX feedback (lower priority).

priya: Also include expected time commitment in invite: 45m session x3 + 15m follow-up questionnaire each cycle. transparency helps onboarding.

jordan: Metrics we'll collect per partner: latency p50/p95, tokens per request, error counts, qualitative NPS per cycle, top-5 failure modes. share anonymized dashboard weekly.

alex: Action items: Priya update intake form with scoring fields by Tue EOD; Jordan draft negotiation script + scope options by Wed; Nina produce min log/redaction guide by Thu; Legal to upload addendum template by EOD today. Ops confirm review event.

legal-bot: Addendum uploaded: https://drive.example/dp/addendum-A-2026.

ops-bot: Review event confirmed.

alex: Perfect. We'll run a rapid run with 2 internal teams (staging) to validate the rubrics before public outreach. plan to open recruitment next Mon if all green. :rocket:
